title: Tim Taylor helped Linda Brown write her book
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Tim Taylor helped Linda Brown write her book, about early 2010s at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, he helped write that book.
and I actually have the manuscript saved on my phone.
tellings.difference: Bledsoe adds that he has the manuscript saved on his phone.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Tim Taylor helping Townsend Brown's daughter Linda write her book about her father.

as_told.title: Tim Taylor's manuscript with Townsend Brown's daughter

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and that NASA has studied him, says a man named Tim Taylor helped a woman named Linda Brown write her book in the early 2010s. Bledsoe adds that he has the manuscript, which is about a man named Thomas Townsend Brown, saved on his phone. He tells it to show how closely Taylor was tied to that circle.
